candidate_policy_scoring.reason: Mandatory support gate failed before policy scoring.

challenge_2025.reason: Preregistered protocol forbids 2025 scoring when no 2024 policy can be risk-certified.

interpretation: The requested Learn-Then-Test formulation was set up on the exact operational risk target: suppressing a true DOWN conditional on an SQRT alarm.
At alpha=20% and 90% confidence, at least 11 actual-DOWN calibration alarms are required even if a candidate policy makes zero bad suppressions.
With n=7, the best-case exact tail is 0.8^7 = 0.2097152, which is larger than delta=0.10.
Therefore no policy can be honestly certified under the frozen risk target from the available 2024 support.
This is a data-support limitation, not a model-performance failure.
decision.next_step: Extend same-clock pre-2025 SQRT+Router support to obtain at least 11 actual-DOWN alarm calibration cases; ideally more because Bonferroni testing of a multi-policy family requires stronger support. Do not weaken alpha/delta or substitute all-daily risk.
